endings.label: Capital Won!
endings.description:
Congratulations! You ended humanity. 
Sorry the sinister aeon is in fact the end of humanity. 
Homogeneity was enforced and capital concentrated all resources
A worn down monoculture was easy pickings for extermination

endings.label: A tragic suicide
endings.description:
Tragically after my arrest I died of suicide with a shotgun to the back of my head.
If only the jail guards weren't busy looking at boat brochures they might have saved me
